config.susinstantswap.title: Su's Instant Swap Config
config.susinstantswap.modEnabled.tooltip: Master switch — when off, the mod is completely disabled and E key behaves like vanilla.
config.susinstantswap.holdThresholdMs.to: Press duration above this is treated as long press. Range: 50-1000ms, default 200ms.
config.susinstantswap.soundEnabled.toolt: Play a sound when swapping items.
config.susinstantswap.mouseReposition.to: Move cursor to bottom-right when a container opens or long press starts.
config.susinstantswap.guiSwapEnabled.too: Press the inventory key on a slot to swap and close the screen.
config.susinstantswap.emptySlotSwapEnabl: Also perform the swap on empty slots.
config.susinstantswap.debug.tooltip: Output debug messages to the game log.
